description:
Upstream's `app.message.dequeue` (Alt+Up) opens an overlay showing all queued steering and follow-up messages, letting the user edit or remove them before they're delivered.

Our Interactive has no dequeue UI. The Session supports `drain_steering/1` and `drain_follow_up/1` but there's no user-facing way to inspect or edit the queues.

Implement: on Alt+Up, drain both queues, show them in an editable overlay (or at minimum a select list with delete), and re-enqueue any the user keeps.

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L2359, `handleDequeue()`.
title: Interactive: message dequeue editing (Alt+Up)
